kitr.name: realtime
kitr.title: Realtime kit
kitr.summary: Start a chat room: typed WebSocket channels that feed the query cache, rooms in the URL.

kit.audience: Anyone building chat, live dashboards or collaboration, where every screen updates at once.

highlights.title: A chat room
highlights.text: Rooms live in the URL, and messages reach every open tab as they are sent.

highlights.title: A typed channel
highlights.text: `app/channels/chat.ts` defines the messages once for the server and the client.

highlights.title: Pick the transport
highlights.text: WebSocket by default, or Socket.IO or server-sent events in `config/realtime.ts`.

highlights.title: Tested end to end
highlights.text: `test/messages.test.ts` sends a message through the API.

run: The chat and its API; open two tabs to see messages arrive
Vitest, starting with the messages test
